newsitem.title: USA: Cosmetic Center says shareholders ok merger.
newsitem.headline: Cosmetic Center says shareholders ok merger.

text.p: The Cosmetic Center Inc COSC.O said Friday it completed the merger with Prestige Fragrance & Cosmetics Inc, the retail outlet subsidiary of Revlon Inc.
The company said its shareholders approved at the merger at its annual meeting Thursday.

The company said Revlon received newly issued Cosmetic Center class C common stock, constituting about 84 percent of its outstanding class C stock after taking into account shares canceled because of the cash election component of the merger.
The company said the new entity will keep the Cosmetic Center name.
